newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse ends mixed, large GarAgent deal.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse ends mixed, large GarAgent deal.

text.p: Hungarian share prices finished mixed on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) on Thursday while BUX index futures also ended trendless, traders said.
The BUX index closed at 3,601.99 points, up 9.44. Spot share turnover totalled 1.13 billion forints.

"The rally which began on Wednesday faltered," said Kalman Schuszter of New York Broker Budapest. "The picture was mixed -- certain shares continued to rise, while those which jumped a lot on Wednesday, like MOL or Richter, fell."
Oil company MOL's shares closed at the day's low of 1,585 forints, down 35. Pharmaceuticals Richter dropped 95 forints to end at 8,355, after bottoming out at 8,350.
Traders saw the market outlook as positive over the next fortnight as companies release their January-September results.
"I expect the market to rise for at least two weeks as company reports arrive," Schuszter said.

A major deal for garage service company GarAgent highlighted trading on Thursday. The transaction saw 30,000 shares -- 7.85 percent of GarAgent's share capital -- change hands at 1,650 forints per share.
BUX index futures closed mixed, reflecting varied opinions over the market's outlook.
The two nearest maturities finished lower by 9.50 and 10.00 points while the three longest rose by 5.00 to 55.00 points. One maturity remained, BSE figures showed.
